direct.description: What documents put on it with no schedule to release it.

kind.description: 1210 Prepayments (by supplier) or 2400 Deferred revenue (by customer).

ledger_balance.description: What the account holds at the end of the run, from the balance service (ENG-04), read positive.

rows.description: One row per customer or supplier.

ties.description: True when the closing total, the direct amounts and what other sources put on the account equal the ledger balance, so that nothing is unexplained.

unexplained.description: What is left when the schedules, the direct amounts and the other sources are taken from the ledger balance: zero when it ties (INV-07).
